# 2 Baruch Chapter 22 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Second Fast and Dialogue

---

**1** Then the heavens opened, and I saw, and a voice from above spoke to me:

**2** Get up, Baruch — listen to what the Mighty God has to say.

**3** Because you have been deeply troubled about Israel, and because your heart breaks for your brother Zion, your prayer has been heard.

**4** A time has been set for this age — it will come, and it will not go one moment beyond what has been decreed.

**5** I know the transgression and what will destroy it. I know its appointed time.

**6** But I won't tell you all of this right now — I don't want to pile grief upon grief, since so much has already been spoken.

**7** Know this, though: the Most High is patient, because he would rather show mercy than carry out judgment.

**8** Just hold on to this one truth: the age is winding down; the times will reach their completion; everything that has been decreed will come to pass.

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic rendering of God's brief divine reply. The heavenly voice refuses to satisfy Baruch's longing for details while insisting everything is under control. The mercy-over-judgment note is theologically central to 2 Baruch.*
